title: BINUH–UNSOH public authority and support evidence refresh
scope: Selected Council authority, official public support reporting and retained financial comparisons. Not an exhaustive amendment, budget-adoption or operational-performance review.

source_records.locator: Final PDF printed pages 5–6, operative paragraphs 10(e) and 11; registry programme-expenditure disclaimer
source_records.claim: OP10(e) directs cost-recovery mission support to BINUH, targeting full responsibility by 1 February 2026. OP11 requires separate quantifiable compacts between the UNSOH head and BINUH head, and between the UNSOH head and GSF Special Representative in consultation with the Force Commander.
limits: A requirement for compacts does not establish that signed compacts were supplied or achieved.
Registry programme expenditure is not expenditure attributable to a mandate.
The original twelve-month GSF authorization cannot establish the current authorization period without follow-up instruments.

source_records.locator: Final PDF printed pages 2–3, operative paragraphs 1, 3 and 7
source_records.claim: The registry records BINUH extension through 31 January 2027. OP3 calls for coordination and avoidance of duplication; OP7 requests costed support options for a Haitian-led DDR programme and related justice/accountability work.
limits: OP7 concerns its specified DDR/justice support scope, not authorization to aggregate all Haiti aviation or support costs.
These selected provisions do not establish compliance or a complete current mandate population.

source_records.locator: PDF pages 2–3 paragraphs 4 and 6; page 8 paragraph 20
source_records.claim: ACABQ distinguishes assessed GSF support, BINUH cost recovery and voluntary funding. It discusses the separate quantifiable compacts and seeks clearer authority/accountability and transition information in subsequent budget reporting.
limits: ACABQ advice is not GA appropriation or proof of GA acceptance.
The report addresses October 2025–June 2026 financing; it does not verify calendar-2027 costs.
No raw PDF copy or file hash is retained by this packet.

source_records.locator: Retained case paragraphs 40–41; fresh search index identifies the report and paragraph 1
source_records.claim: The retained dossier attributes the February handover and helicopter activity to paragraphs 40–41. This refresh found the official report index but did not freshly inspect those paragraphs.
limits: Retained claims remain at their original evidence cutoff.
Reported handover is not a signed SLA, fulfilled compact, complete flight population, settled invoice or net-cost finding.

source_records.locator: Official establishment notice, first three paragraphs
source_records.claim: The indexed official notice reports that the February BINUH mission-support target was achieved and describes UNSOH operational establishment as of April.
limits: Management reporting does not authenticate actual service coverage, performance, invoices or cash.
A later September operational update uses initial-operating-capability terminology; these descriptions must not be treated as quantified SLA acceptance.

source_records.locator: Official article dated 21 September 2026, opening and initial-operating-capability discussion
source_records.claim: The indexed article describes UNSOH support to GSF and BINUH and identifies 1 April as initial operating capability while planned resources were still being established.
limits: This is not a service-level or financial performance population.
No claim of full operational readiness is inferred from the article title or a reported milestone.

source_records.locator: Official registry operative paragraphs 1–3; official Council resolution index dated 29 September 2026
source_records.claim: OP1 extends GSF until 31 March 2027 and requests continued logistical and operational support through UNSOH in full compliance with resolution 2793(2025). OP2 requests six-month reporting on the benchmarks in 2793 OP24. OP3 notes the Haiti–GSF status agreement of 27 July 2026.
limits: The final PDF link redirected to the ODS error page; Council-index PDF access returned HTTP403.
The GSF end date is not independently assigned to every UNSOH service obligation.
Selected registry provisions do not prove performance, appropriation or completeness of later amendments.

source_records.locator: Retained pages 107–109 paragraphs 273–275; control rows BH01–BH05
source_records.claim: Retained controls record USD1.4m proposed aviation reduction, USD4m all-support reimbursement, USD3m versus USD1.6m aviation comparators and USD3.7964m net other-supplies/services increase containing the reimbursement.
limits: These are retained proposal figures, not GA approvals or observed expenditure.
The USD1.4m effect is already embedded and cannot be newly attributed to this project.
The USD4m payment is an internal transfer across a broader service scope, not an amount to subtract directly from aviation reduction.
Supplier costs, retained work, transition costs and comparable fiscal periods remain unavailable.

public_questions_resolved_with_limits: Final primary PDFs verify selected cost-recovery, coordination and separate-compact provisions in resolutions 2793 and 2814.
ACABQ advice distinguishes funding streams and identifies accountability/transition information needs.
Official indexed management reports corroborate that support delivery was reported; they do not supply independent operational acceptance.
The September 2829 registry operative text verifies continued UNSOH support linked to 2793 and a GSF extension to 31 March 2027; its final PDF remains unfetched.
public_questions_remaining: Retrieve the final 2829 text and check later amendments/corrigenda and applicability; selected provisions in final 2793 and 2814 PDFs were checked.
Authenticate the 2027 BINUH proposal passages and any paragraph-specific GA disposition; do not substitute ACABQ advice.
Review subsequent implementation reporting, including the official October report identified as S/2026/800, for dated compact and support-performance evidence.

minimum_internal_evidence_addendum.authority_basis: S/RES/2793(2025) OP11, final primary PDF printed page 6
minimum_internal_evidence_addendum.custodian_role_to_confirm: UNSOH controller and mission support leadership

minimum_internal_evidence_addendum.authority_basis: Case C03 decision question; not a newly inferred legal disclosure obligation
minimum_internal_evidence_addendum.custodian_role_to_confirm: Both controllers, aviation/procurement and HR custodians

decision_boundary: Public-source progress supports a more precise evidence request. It does not advance the candidate, authorize collection or implementation, verify a compact, establish financial validation or recognize savings.
review_limitations: Selected bounded search only; absence of a fetched document does not establish that a document or requirement does not exist.
Official registry, final primary text, indexed official reporting and retained repository transcription are different evidence levels.
No raw PDF bytes or live restricted records were collected; no custodian was contacted.
